Icons from ThornyFFXI/mobdb (MIT License, see LICENSE), as shipped in the XIUI addon 1.8.4 (submodules/mobdb/icons).
Used for the nameplate icon row: aggressive/passive (NQ, and HQ for notorious monsters), link and detection. The damage
icons (Slashing, Piercing, Impact, H2H and the eight elements) and the status icons (`Immune*.png`) from the same release
are used for the badge group: what a mob is weak to, resists and is immune to.
